subject: pe
title: Anatomy: Muscles
welcome_lead: Muscles pull bones in pairs — push, pull, lift and twist.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: muscles, voluntary/involuntary, antagonistic pairs.
final_note: No muscle pushes — they all pull. Movement comes from pairs.

concepts.def: Tissue that pulls bones to move you.
Front arm muscle that bends elbow.
Back arm muscle that straightens elbow.

walkthroughs.body_html: Voluntary muscles (skeletal) move when you tell them. Involuntary ones (heart, gut) keep working without thinking.
Muscles work in antagonistic pairs. When your biceps shortens, your triceps relaxes — and the elbow bends.
Muscles use sugar and oxygen for energy. Hard exercise can cause lactic acid — the burn — and they tire.
